title: 15th Annual SYSK Halloween Spooktacular!
summary: Halloween Spooktacular episode in which Josh and Chuck (with guest producer Ben and producer Jerry mentioned) read two public-domain horror stories aloud, with no ads. First is "The Woman's Ghost Story" by Algernon Blackwood (transcribed as Aldrin in Blackwood), told from a woman's point of view: a psychical researcher spends a night in a haunted London lodging house and meets the ghost of a man who was frightened to death there, who asks for love and sympathy. Second is "The Middle Toe of the Right Foot" by Ambrose Bierce: a stranger overhears gossip about Manton, who murdered his wife and children, is challenged to a knife duel in a dark room, and is found dead in the abandoned Manton house, with the footprints of his murdered wife and children leading to him; the wife's footprints lack a middle toe on the right foot. The hosts note the episode is ad-free and falls on Halloween, and close with a sign-off.

entities.name: The Middle Toe of the Right Foot

segments.title: Opening banter and setup
segments.summary: Hosts open the Spooktacular, explain the tradition of reading public domain spooky stories aloud, note the episode is ad-free, and discuss choosing a story written by a woman.

segments.title: The Woman's Ghost Story by Algernon Blackwood
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck read Blackwood's story narrated by a psychical researcher who spends a night in a haunted London house, meets the ghost of a man frightened to death there, and is drawn into an emotional encounter with him; her uncle Sir Henry then reveals the story was a test.

segments.title: Introduction to The Middle Toe of the Right Foot
segments.summary: Josh introduces Ambrose Bierce's story and the hosts briefly discuss its confusing structure and characters before reading begins.

segments.title: The Middle Toe of the Right Foot, chapter one
segments.summary: The narrative introduces the reputedly haunted Manton House near Marshall, then four men arrive in a wagon; one, Grossmith, is forced into a knife duel in a dark room, and the men leave. A farm boy reports seeing a white-clad figure on the wagon, and the newspaper publishes the story without any claimant.

segments.title: The Middle Toe of the Right Foot, chapter two
segments.summary: Flashback: in the Marshall hotel porch, Rosser, King and Sancher discuss a stranger, Robert Grossmith, who is overhearing them. They mention Manton and his wife who lacked a toe, and a duel is arranged with knives for the next evening.

segments.title: The Middle Toe of the Right Foot, chapter three and ending
segments.summary: Sheriff Adams, Deputy King and Brewer visit the house and find Manton dead in a corner, with footprints of his murdered wife and children leading to him; the wife's right footprint is missing its middle toe. The hosts comment on the ending.

segments.title: Sign-off
segments.summary: Hosts wish listeners a happy Halloween, skip listener mail, give an email address, and end the episode.
